title: Cleanshot, No F1.
description: No more pressing F1 for screenshots. Just F2.
body:
**Welcome to CleanShot, a mod that removes the hassle of pressing F1 entirely!**


_Ever been tired of pressing F1 > F2 > F1 every time you want to take a clean screenshot?_

Nothing more, nothing less. No bloat, no extras. Just simple, basic, and helpful.

When you press F2, all of your screenshots will instantly remove all elements of the HUD, including your Inventory, HP Bar, and Hunger Bar, to just leave the beauty of your surroundings. 

So why you waiting? If you're here, you probably need this. Cmon, don't be lazy!

If you have any problems, there's a Discord link on your right!

Thank You - 
Corrupt3r


![An image you could take, with just F2.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5ebecfe0c0c6336391c2e2e5e79e24cc4a7290b1_0.webp)
